breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines the bending moment as M(x) = P(L-x), which is the linearly varying moment along the span, rather than using the constant peak value M = PL as stated in the incomplete prompt. This aligns with the ground truth approach of setting up the actual M(x) function and integrating it properly.
